startDateBeforeEndDate: startDate must be before or equal to endDate
preferencesRequired: Both language and timezone are required when creating preferences
scopeRequiredForRecurring: Scope is required when modifying a recurring entry
recurrenceByDayRequiresWeekly: Day selection is only valid for weekly recurrence
recurrenceUntilBeforeStart: Recurrence end date must be on or after start date
